title: UI test framework
summary: Scripted keyboard, pointer and text input reaches GUI programs through the window manager with a recorded outcome for every event; their trees and committed frames are captured whole and compared to independent expectations at acknowledged clock epochs and causal barriers; every planted defect is caught for its own reason; and every failure leaves its evidence, on every target.
